summary: This standards-track RFC describes how Ethernet Shortest Path Bridging in MAC mode can be combined with Ethernet VPN to interwork with provider backbone bridging edges as in RFC 7623. Each attached Ethernet network is operationally isolated from the EVPN core and from the others.

eli5.summary: Two different kinds of road systems need to meet at a junction. This explains how to connect them so traffic can flow without the two systems getting tangled up.

questions: connecting shortest path bridging to evpn
